control: working tree snapshot at start of sliding-window task; progressive chunk delivery with read-completion scheduling; Go overlay for scheduler.go, reader.go, state.go, scope.go and an empty prefetch_session.go
candidate: same Quark defaults, progressive block delivery and 3 s target takeover, with scope-owned cursor-bounded completion/consumption driven prefetch, capacity notifications, bounded batched tails and cleared retired range references
seek_workload: 20 fixed offsets i * (406288683 - 1048576) // 20; new FD; 1 MiB pread; F_NOCACHE; idle drain and VFS clear before each point
sequential_workload: 256 contiguous 1 MiB pread from offset 0, new FD, F_NOCACHE, idle drain and VFS clear; 8 MiB intervals include startup and tail
cache: durable cache disabled globally and per mount; within-sample hot chunks reused; metadata, URL, nonce and CDN caches remain

prior_attempts.reason: Unbatched tail caused extra short requests; all initial full rounds and interrupted exploratory samples retained separately

limits: Mounted completion is not player decode/render time or literal CDN TTFB
Cold clearing resets stage/session history: initial small FUSE reads become sequential within each point
Executor plaintext body bytes exclude nonce/private HTTP/headers/TLS, and do not represent full wire amplification
actual_in_flight is per trace/window; aggregate source peak was not sampled in these live runs
Three 256 MiB passes per arm do not establish physical maximum bandwidth or long-duration player acceptance
Cloud/provider drift and span variability must be evaluated from all rounds; no default-policy tuning from a single fast run
No full local CI overlaps the final cloud measurements; final verification follows measurement
Other backend acceptance and the original 6.2/6.3 performance gates remain incomplete
code_status: uncommitted working tree; control frozen before sliding-window work; final candidate uses bounded batched tail fills

policy.interactive_prefetch: adaptive; confirmed sequential caller chunk requests resolve to 16 chunks per window and depth up to four

decision: Keep the requested scheduling architecture and existing driver defaults; no proven throughput gain or stable maximum-bandwidth claim. Final sequential request counts match the control; per-round latency/throughput noise exceeds original acceptance in some cases, so tasks 6.2/6.3 stay open.
post_measurement_change: Restore merged-window shifting for callers without a session controller and ReadStream after full-CI regression. The measured FUSE session controller calls the bounded helper with the same horizon, batching and execution; no driver default changed. Related VFS race rerun and full CI cover final code.

verification.gofmt: all changed Go files formatted with current module GOROOT gofmt; -l empty
verification.targeted_race: drive, readbudget, vfs/read, crypt passed; five session stress rounds passed; final unhinted-window VFS race passed three rounds
verification.cleanup: 15 owned isolated mounts/configs/runtimes and three binaries removed; private raw results/scripts/overlays retained; user processes/config unchanged
